variant.title: Fog of War Sudoku
variant.description: Solve the Sudoku while correct entries reveal nearby hidden cells.
rule_guide.title: Fog of War Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: At the start, each given digit and the cells immediately around it are revealed.
rule_guide.item_3: Enter the correct digit in a revealed cell to reveal that cell and the cells immediately around it.
rule_guide.item_4: Wrong digits and notes do not reveal new cells.
